content: Dataset collection methods: (1) Scripted policies — privileged simulator state access, scalable, 100% success rate, but lacks corrective behaviors; (2) Teleoperation — human via VR/leader-arm/keyboard, captures natural strategies, lower throughput; (3) RL rollouts — adds failure-adjacent states for robustness. Standard format: RLDS (used by Open X-Embodiment, Octo, OpenVLA) or HDF5 (LIBERO native). Metadata required: camera intrinsics/extrinsics, robot URDF, action space definition, task spec. LIBERO provides 500 expert demos per suite (10 tasks × 50 each) via scripted policy in robosuite simulator.
